profile.headline: Brown University Graduate
profile.geoLocationName: East Greenwich, Rhode Island, United States
profile.jobTitle: Software Developer and Social Media Manager
profile.summary:
I'm an effective graphic design artist and full stack web developer. A driven and enthusiastic Computer Science major at Brown, I have experience taking a website from wireframe to deployment. I work well with colleagues, customers, and children and have experience managing a team. I am often noted for working quickly and diligently, being willing to engage with my work and superiors, and responding well to feedback.
Personally, I love art and video games, I take great pleasure in developing personal projects, and I hope to develop a showcase of my work on social media. I speak French and Spanish and I am currently working towards proficiency in ASL.

positions.title: Software Developer and Social Media Manager
positions.description: Redesigned and updated the lab website to better reflect their current projects and campus presence. Developed UI and user experience for research products developed by current researchers. Developed software for use in bioinformatics analysis, starting from workflows and continuing to a functional product.
positions.insights: Skills: Figma (Software) · Express.js · Node.js · Wix Website Builder · Docker

positions.title: IT Lead and Full-Stack Developer
positions.locationName: Pawtucket, Rhode Island, United States · Remote
positions.description: At Pawtucket Primary Care I designed and realized a full, responsive website according to the specific needs of our target clientele. Following the launch of the website, I created a suite of logos, business cards, and other media related to brand development. I manage domains, SEO and discovery, and social media marketing across multiple platforms, working to create a cohesive and prominent brand.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Computer Science · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Web Development · Brand Development · Social Media Marketing · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Graphic Designer and Full-Stack Developer
positions.description: Worked closely with a small team to build a website from initial conception, create a great user experience, and manage the code base effectively. Received valuable experience creating and revising effective designs and working with colleagues to resolve technical issues. Created and iterated on wireframes in Figma, coded in React with a Firebase database and deployed with Github.
positions.insights: Skills: User Interface Design · Graphic Design · Computer Science · Figma (Software) · Front-End Development · TypeScript · User Experience (UX) · Web Development · React.js · Firebase · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Lead Sales Associate
positions.locationName: Warwick, Rhode Island, United States · On-site
positions.description: One of few employees designated for training in the evaluation system. Noted for speed and quality of tagging, as well as attention to detail on the floor. Assigned to delegate, coordinate, and train new employees in my area.
positions.insights: Skills: Retail · Team Management · Customer Service · Training

positions.title: Residential Advisor
positions.locationName: Providence, Rhode Island, United States · On-site
positions.description: Managed university residents and coordinated with coworkers to conceptualize, advertise, budget, and host events effectively. Effectively disseminated information to residents and resolved breaches of conduct.

positions.title: Swim Instructor
positions.locationName: Providence, Rhode Island, United States · On-site
positions.description: Learned and taught a swim instruction curriculum to kids aged 8-12 as well as youth and adult joint sessions. Managed groups of 1-4 children in a pool setting, documented progress and maintained positive relationships with parents.
